classification_policy.matching: Matches only its explicitly stated scope; never inferred full calculator parity.
classification_policy.partial: Related implementation exists, with missing/different sequencing, presentation, semantics or unverified boundaries.
classification_policy.enhanced-only: Existing additional teaching presentation/interface to retain only in an enhancement profile.
classification_policy.incorrect: Known discrepancy established by source or recorded reference comparison.
classification_policy.missing: No corresponding function/controller at this revision.

reference_sources.scope: Prior live reset, all panel positions, 1+2, edit/history, mode and HOME.
Prior fresh-reset live divide-by-zero Error 2 and ON/C recovery.
Prior live modes, menu selections, CNST and CONV results.
Decision 11 explicitly reserves additional exact-surd presentation for enhancement profile.
EL506-076 ten-digit mantissa and two-digit exponent; implementation formatting policy differs.
EL506-041 pointer/touch/keyboard must emit same canonical physical events.

live_session.initial_state: Fresh launcher default observed; chrome Reset action outcome not verified.
live_session.limitation: Computer Use failed to activate captured window during Reset attempt; target reselection/activation recovery failed with same error. No further UI input issued. New arithmetic/surd probes not claimed; prior live transcripts remain selected reference.
